result.description:
Position: Motor Mechanic
Type: Full-time
Employer: Pakenham Radiators and Mechanical Services Pty Ltd
Location: Pakenham VIC 3810
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Pakenham Radiators and Mechanical Services Pty Ltd is a well-established automotive workshop specialising in radiator repairs, recoring, flushes, assemblies and custom builds, while also delivering comprehensive mechanical services including logbook servicing, general repairs and air conditioning re-gas and repairs. Serving the local Pakenham community, the business is known for its technical expertise, modern equipment and strong focus on quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring every vehicle leaves the workshop performing safely and reliably.
About the Position:
The Motor Mechanic role is central to the workshop’s day-to-day operations, responsible for accurately diagnosing vehicle faults, performing high-quality repairs and maintenance, and ensuring vehicles are returned to customers in optimal condition. This position plays a key part in upholding the business’s reputation for reliable automotive service and supporting efficient workshop throughput.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose vehicles by mechanical testing and observation
Provide detailed estimates of repairs and replacements
Repair and replace diagnosed issues
Conduct routine maintenance and service aiming to vehicle functionality and longevity
Test drive vehicles after repairs to ensure complete repair work is performed
File appropriate documentation on service and repair works completed
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate IV or higher trade qualifications.
Minimum 3 years of work experience; experience in radiator repair preferred.
Highly motivated with the ability to work autonomously, strong technical diagnostic and repair skills, and a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Home Services Lead | BlueCare | Beenleigh Bethania Haven Aged Care Facility

Employment Term: Full time Monday to Friday, with availability to work weekends when required.

Located in: Beenleigh Bethania Haven Aged Care Facility 

Remuneration: $39.21 per hour + Super + Not for Profit Salary Packaging + Penalties & Allowances 

Make a meaningful difference with BlueCare 

We're looking for someone who wants to build meaningful relationships and make a difference in the lives of others - through small moments that leave big impacts. 

About the role: 

As our Home Services Lead, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality, person-centred services across home environments-ensuring every interaction reflects care, safety, and excellence. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide your team, oversee daily operations, and drive service performance, creating a positive experience for residents, families, and stakeholders alike. 

In this role, you will: 

Lead the day-to-day delivery of food services, cleaning, and laundry services

Coach, support, and develop your team, building a strong, accountable, and engaged culture

Ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently, and to a consistently high standard

Oversee workflow, rostering, and operational performance

Maintain compliance with food safety, infection control, and quality standards

Build positive relationships with residents, families, and internal stakeholders 

Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and enhance the customer experience

Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, quality, and care 

Role requirements: 

As an experienced service operations leader, ideally within aged care, healthcare, or a similar environment, you'll be self-motivated, proactive, and bring strong leadership capability. You'll empower your team to deliver safe, high-quality, person-centred services, while reinforcing the importance of food safety, compliance, and continuous improvement. You'll demonstrate: 

Strong knowledge of food safety, infection control, and service standards, supported by experience in a regulated environment

Experience leading teams across kitchen operations, cleaning and-or laundry services

Proven leadership capability, including coaching, rostering, and building a positive team culture 

A proactive approach to problem-solving, organisation, and continuous improvement 

Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with residents, families, and stakeholders 

Essential qualifications & licences: 

Certificate IV in Leadership & Management (or Diploma) - Desirable 

A relevant trade or operational qualification (e.g. Certificate IV in Hospitality, Commercial Cookery or similar), or equivalent supervisory experience 

Food Safety Supervisor Certification

Ability to satisfy all required probity checks in line with legislation and BlueCare policies 

Employee Benefits: 

Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum 

A recognition and rewards platform, providing employee discounts at hundreds of retailers, including everyday expenses, holidays, health insurance, annual awards celebration, wellbeing and employee assistance programs 

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme 

Diversity and inclusive leave, offering paid gender affirmation leave and cultural leave options (paid and unpaid) for those who may celebrate Lunar New Year, Diwali, Ramadan, NAIDOC weeks and other significant cultural events 

Career development opportunities with one of the most trusted community and residential care providers in Australia to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

BlueCare is proudly part of the UnitingCare Family, we'd love you to be too

Joining the state's largest network of aged care workers with its over 8,000 strong, bright team in blue, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. With more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, you are part of something bigger. Our team are compassionate, inclusive and committed to the work we do, helping people live life in all its fullness.

Child safe, Child friendly 

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will: 

Provide welcoming, safe & nurturing services for children 

Implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services

Appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur 

Abide by the Child Safe Standards and adhere to the Reportable Conduct Scheme 

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple -everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position. For additional support and to meet our RAP Team, email reconciliation@ucareqld.com.au

Safe workplace 

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety.

Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard. Our recruitment and workplace practices reflect our dedication in preventing abuse, harm and exploitation across UnitingCare.    Click here to Apply now →

Restaurant Manager - Amherst Sushi

A WA-based Japanese restaurant with multiple locations (Canning Vale, Noranda, Mt Hawthorn) operating under the Amherst Sushi brand, is seeking a manager able to work across different service locations. 

About Us

Amherst Sushi is seeking an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to join our team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of our Japanese restaurant locations, maintaining high standards of customer dining experience, supervising staff, coordinating stock and suppliers, and supporting the consistent operation of our restaurant business.

Key Responsibilities

-  Manage the daily operations of the restaurant, including customer service, staff coordination and overall service flow.
-  Maintain high standards of food quality, presentation, customer service, hygiene and food safety.
-  Coordinate with chefs and kitchen staff to ensure smooth restaurant service.
-  Handle customer enquiries, feedback and complaints professionally.
-  Assist with menu planning, seasonal offerings and promotional activities.
-  Manage stock control, supplier communication, procurement and inventory checks.
-  Recruit, train and supervise front-of-house and back-of-house staff.
-  Prepare rosters, coordinate shifts and ensure adequate staffing levels.
-  Manage POS systems, daily reconciliation, transaction records and basic reporting.
-  Assist with budgeting, cost control, workplace compliance and WHS requirements.
-  Support the consistent implementation of service standards, menu updates and operational procedures across Amherst Sushi locations as reasonably required.

About You

-  Previous experience as a Restaurant Manager, Store Manager, Café Manager, Food and Beverage Manager, Duty Supervisor or in a similar hospitality management role is required.
-  Successful candidates will have least 3 years experience in a fast paced hospitality or food service environment.  
-  Strong understanding of daily restaurant operations, customer service, staff supervision, stock control and food safety requirements.
-  Experience with rostering, POS systems, daily sales records, supplier communication and basic operational reporting will be highly regarded.
-  Strong communication, leadership, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work under pressure in a busy full-service restaurant environment.
-  Experience in Japanese cuisine, sushi restaurant operations, café operations or Asian food and beverage businesses will be highly regarded.
-  Multilingual communication skills and a genuine commitment to long-term full-time employment will be highly regarded.

Why join Us
-  Fast paced high growth food service business with opportunities to grow. 
-  Attractive compensation $80,000 - $90,000 pa plus super. 
-  Supportive environment and team. 

Apply directly with a resume.

Delivering exceptional customer service to our passengers at all times

A current HR driver licence

A strong focus and commitment to safe, reliable, professional driving and exceptional customer service
